newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint closes little changed vs dlr at 189.17/22.
newsitem.headline: Forint closes little changed vs dlr at 189.17/22.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed lacklustre trading on Wednesday little changed against the dollar and firmly on the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid), traders said.
The forint finished at 189.17/22 against the U.S. unit, up from midday's 189.22/27 and compared with an opening of 188.95/189.00.
The forint remained pinned to the NBH bid throughout the day and traders added there was hardly any activity during the afternoon session.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
